messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - KV-cache prefetch storm causing >5x batch drop rate for runtime-group batchers (region-us-west)

maria: seeing massive 429s and batch fragmentation on batcher-3 across host pool
jordan: logs show a ton of toolcall responses with huge structured arrays
maria: looks like structured output from our external tool call returns variable-length JSON arrays that blow up KV key prefixes
zoe: can we throttle prefetching? this looks like prefetch + structured arrays => KV key explosion
oncall-bot: @maria you're onpager
maria: ack, joining live
jordan: metric snapshot: batch_success_rate down 18% -> 5%, kv_cache_size +460% in 5m
jordan: here's a representative log fragment:

```
2026-03-15T12:14:22Z batcher-3 ERROR kv_cache: insert failed key=tools/struct/resp/abc123 len=987654 err=OOM
2026-03-15T12:14:22Z batcher-3 WARN  batch: fragment_count=12 tokens=20480 toolcall=true
```

tyler: we rolled the structured-output transformer yesterday; could be regression
maria: I can confirm the structured transformer is writing a composite prefix using the full array hash, creating low cache hit rate
cs-lead: any customer impact yet? which customers are seeing errors?
zoe: two high-traffic customers are seeing degraded completion times and timeouts
jordan: recreated locally: toolcall -> structured array length spikes -> batch splits into many tiny batches -> KV keys unique per request -> cache misses
maria: immediate mitigation: disable prefetch for toolcall route on prod and reduce max_batch_tokens
maria: propose applying env override on batchers: `REDWOOD_PREFETCH_TOOLCALL=false` and `BATCHER_MAX_TOKENS=4096`
platform-eng: prepping patch for runtime config now
deploy-bot: starting canary: apply-config batchers/us-west/3 -> REDWOOD_PREFETCH_TOOLCALL=false
maria: applying hotfix to us-west first, then regional rollout
jordan: also add immediate rate-limit on structured tool responses to avoid stampede
maria: command to run on infra console:

```
rctl set-env --group batchers/us-west --env REDWOOD_PREFETCH_TOOLCALL=false
rctl set-config --group batchers/us-west --key batcher.max_tokens --value 4096
```

zoe: i'm toggling prefetch off for group batchers/us-west/0..5
maria: rolling patch applied to us-west; metrics: kv_cache_size flattening, batch_success_rate recovering to 65%
jordan: good, errors down, but we still see per-request spikes for structured outputs
tyler: next step: add a transformer guard to cap returned array sizes at 512 elements and fall back to streaming
maria: agree — short-term hotfix: block-toolcall-structured for flagged customers
cs-lead: notifying impacted customers: 2 customers with degraded throughput, CS drafted messages
cs-lead: message sent, offering mitigation workaround: disable structured outputs in integration
oncall-bot: handoff in 30m to @tyler
maria: documenting quick RCA: structured-array + prefetch -> unique KV key churn -> cache blowup -> batch fragmentation
platform-eng: plan for durable fix: transformer change + batching kernel tweak to detect high-cardinality keys
tyler: creating PR for transformer guard: limit array length + add checksum prefix to KV keys to reduce cardinality
maria: followup tasks assigned in incident tracker: #1234 (hotfix postmortem), #1235 (transformer guard), #1236 (batcher telemetry)
jordan: putting postmortem draft in docs, anyone want to coauthor?
zoe: i'll add timeline and customer impact
maria: thanks team. leaving notes for next oncall. handoff: watch kv_cache_size and batch_success_rate, if re-regress -> rollback structured transformer in all regions
tyler: ack, taking oncall
maria: offpager, thanks everyone :heart:
incident-bot: Incident marked: mitigation in progress — severity P0 -> monitoring
